rows.answer: The case files do not show why Team 7's prototype was stolen or who the thief was working for. The files show that Team 7's silver ThinkPad X1 Carbon laptop and Lumen Band prototype were stolen from table T-07 overnight [EMAIL-003][NOTE-001]. The laptop held the team's only copy of their source code because they had not pushed to their GitHub repository [EMAIL-003][STMT-001], and its Find My Device location last checked in near Hanover Quay at 02:21 on 4 October 2026 [EMAIL-004].
